title: Project rotation claims every waiting project is read within bounded passes, but a fleet that stays full keeps the cursor and the same batch, so a project beyond the batch is never read
resolution: Bounded the read to passes whose offers move the cursor; scenario Fleet full for many passes and its test (c7d4f298) added; contract section 13 aligned. The gap predates the change: the base kept the cursor after the first fleet decline too.

title: The claim that no later task fits unless capacity frees ignores a new candidate, renewed eligibility, cleared admission pressure, or lifted quarantine between transactions
resolution: Conditioned the claim on unchanged candidates, eligibility, quarantine, and capacity in contract section 5, design, and verification; newly available capacity is deferred to the next pass.

title: Placed by the next pass and up to 5 s later are not guaranteed: another replica or an earlier task may take the slot, and the next pass starts 5 s after a pass ends
resolution: Reworded in design, proposal, and verification to offered in the next pass, in rotation order; timing bounded to one replica without intervening changes, with no hard 5 s bound, as runPeriodically waits after each pass.

title: The test a decline after the fleet ran out of capacity does not move the cursor no longer reaches its scenario, since the pass stops at task-b1
resolution: Removed; the RotationCursor test (resource-admission.test.ts:259) covers the guard. Replaced by a reachable test, a fleet that stays full keeps the cursor until capacity returns.

title: Scenario Capacity freed during a pass expects the next pass to place the declined task, which fails when earlier offers were own declines and one placement, leaving the cursor before a later project
resolution: The WHEN names the first offer of the pass, a task of p-b, and drops the obsolete clause; the unit and PostgreSQL tests both decline the first offer of their pass.

title: The proposal says the declined project is offered first among the projects after it, which is false when the cursor stops at an earlier placement
resolution: Reworded: offered before any project after it in the next read's rotation.

title: Known limit lists placed tasks among the offers before a fleet capacity decline, though nothing is placed on a full fleet
The proposal says a full fleet costs one declined placement transaction per pass, ignoring declines checked before the worker
resolution: Reworded at lines 9 and 22 to at most one placement transaction per pass that a fleet capacity decline rolls back, as the contract and design.

title: Task 2.1 lists the own-decline test among tests failing before the fix, though it passes before and after
resolution: Task 2.1 now names it a guard test that passes before and after.

title: Task 4.2 is unticked although review pass 1 is recorded
The record omits that the pass 1 records commit also changed the design.md citation and says it added only check results
resolution: Both lines name the design.md citation fix of 229e7596; fixed in the records commit of review pass 2.

title: The record groups the #settle comment with comments that said a pass stops only when the store fails, though it was about waits
resolution: The #settle comment is described apart; fixed in the records commit of review pass 2.

title: The FLEET_REASONS comment cites sections 5 and 13 without saying they are contract sections
Two test comments say none for the rest, naming later fleet capacity declines that a pass no longer reaches
resolution: Both comments, here and placement.integration.test.ts:187, now say the long jitter would apply were the fleet capacity decline to back off.

title: The pass 2 result line placed every pass 2 finding in the spec and the records, although two are in source and test comments
resolution: The inaccurate clause is removed from the pass 2 result line.
